strategy.summary: TODO-7 adds completing, filtering and clearing todos to the static todo app (public/app.js; state lives in page memory, so each page load starts empty). Playwright e2e tests against the real app served by server.js must prove that ticking/unticking toggles strike-through and the items-left count, that All/Active/Completed show the right todos and mark the selected filter pressed, and that "Clear completed" shows only while something is completed and removes every completed todo.
inScope: Checkbox toggle: strike-through on the title and #count text
Filter buttons All/Active/Completed: visible todos and aria-pressed
outOfScope: Persistence across reloads (the app keeps todos in memory only; the ticket doesn't ask for it)
assumptions: The real app runs for real via the existing playwright.config.js webServer (node server.js on 4173); nothing is faked - there is no backend API.
Each test opens a fresh page, so todo state is per test; titles are distinct and none is a substring of another.
"Struck through" is checked as the title span's computed text-decoration-line being line-through (styles.css li.completed span), and absent when unticked.
None of these actions can be refused by the app (no validation), so there is no refusal case; the negative side is covered by Clear completed being hidden when nothing is completed.

risks.description: Count text or strike-through not updated on untick (state drift)
risks.mitigation: TC2 asserts both revert after unticking

risks.description: Clear completed removes only one completed todo or also active ones
risks.mitigation: TC7 completes two of three todos and asserts only the active one remains

risks.description: Filter list re-renders detach the checkbox (check() hangs under Active filter)
risks.mitigation: Tick todos under the All filter before switching filters; assert the list

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ticking a todo's checkbox strikes its title through and decreases the items-left count by one; unticking removes the strike-through and increases the count by one.
Active shows only uncompleted todos, Completed only completed todos, All every todo; the selected filter button has aria-pressed=true and the others false.
"Clear completed" is visible only while at least one todo is completed, and clicking it removes every completed todo and no active one.

testCases.title: ticking a todo strikes it through and decrements the items left count
preconditions: Fresh page with todos 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent' added
testCases.expected: 'Walk dog' checkbox checked and its title has line-through; 'Pay rent' title not struck through; #count reads exactly '1 item left' (was '2 items left')

testCases.title: unticking a completed todo removes the strike-through and increments the items left count
preconditions: Todos 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent', 'Walk dog' ticked ('1 item left')
testCases.expected: Checkbox unchecked, title text-decoration-line none, #count reads exactly '2 items left'
testCases.rationale: Ticket requires reversal of both effects

testCases.title: Active filter shows only uncompleted todos and is pressed
preconditions: Todos 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent', 'Water plants'; 'Pay rent' ticked
testCases.expected: List titles exactly ['Walk dog', 'Water plants']; Active aria-pressed=true, All and Completed false

testCases.title: Completed filter shows only completed todos and is pressed
preconditions: Todos 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent', 'Water plants'; 'Pay rent' ticked
testCases.expected: List titles exactly ['Pay rent']; Completed aria-pressed=true, All and Active false

testCases.title: All filter shows every todo again and is pressed
preconditions: Todos 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent', 'Water plants'; 'Pay rent' ticked; Completed filter selected
testCases.expected: List titles exactly ['Walk dog', 'Pay rent', 'Water plants']; All aria-pressed=true, Active and Completed false
testCases.rationale: Returning to All restores the full list

testCases.title: Clear completed is hidden until a todo is completed and hidden again when it is unticked
preconditions: Todos 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent' added, none ticked
steps: Assert list loaded and button hidden
testCases.expected: Button hidden, then visible after tick, then hidden after untick
testCases.rationale: Visibility rule of AC3, including its negative side

testCases.title: Clear completed removes every completed todo and keeps active ones
preconditions: Todos 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent', 'Water plants'; 'Walk dog' and 'Water plants' ticked
testCases.expected: List titles exactly ['Pay rent']; #count '1 item left'; Clear completed hidden
testCases.rationale: Removing more than one completed todo catches a remove-only-first bug

strategy.environmentNotes: Playwright's webServer in playwright.config.js starts `node server.js` on port 4173 (baseURL http://localhost:4173). No env vars, no seed data; Chromium only.
